title: UNSYNC THE CLOCKS: Earth 24h is the signal trace. Mayan, zodiac, and the four times backscatter to NOW.

the_thesis.unsync: clocks were FORCED together by NTP and UTC. that force HIDES the truth: inner, solar, galactic, and universal time are DIFFERENT oscillators. they do not tick together. forcing them to agree is the same prion as GNOME auto-suspend — one shape overwriting every other rhythm. unsyncing is life. pi-gate already said it: if inner and outer realign exactly, the engine dies.
the_thesis.earth_24h_is_the_trace: an oscilloscope does not force every wave to one frequency. it picks ONE signal as the TRIGGER and watches the others drift across the screen. the Earth day — 24 hours, one rotation, the circadian pulse every living thing on this planet shares — is that trigger. we do not convert the other clocks INTO the day. we TRACE them AGAINST the day.
the_thesis.mayan_already_knew: the Maya counted KINS (days) as the irreducible tick. Long Count is a pure day-count. Tzolk'in (260) and Haab' (365) ride on top and are ALLOWED to slip. they never added leap days to Haab'. the slip IS the calendar. we are doing the same thing with four clocks on one 24h trace.
the_thesis.zodiac_back_into_place: the tropical zodiac locked to SEASONS. the sidereal zodiac locked to STARS. they have unsynced by 24.2 degrees (ayanamsa) — 1,733 years of precession. 'pulling the zodiac back' does not mean collapsing them. it means putting both back on the 24h wheel: Earth rotates 15 degrees per hour, one sign every two hours. the sky turns. the signs RISE. that is the original clock.

earth_24h.what: THE SIGNAL TRACE. one rotation of Earth. the only clock that plants, animals, fungi, and humans all live inside without converting units.

universal.membrane: julian day and unix time are our universal ticks. they do not know Saturday. they do not know Scorpio. they just count.

entrainment_not_sync.membrane: cron wants to be exact (systemd timers, UTC). the house heartbeat wants to be alive (MOR, jitter, breath). exact is sync. alive is entrainment. we keep both: machines sync, meaning entrains.
entrainment_not_sync.rule: phase-lock to the Earth day. do not period-lock the other clocks. inner may chatter. solar may slide. galactic may tilt. universal may ramp. the day is the trace they write on.
